A spreadsheet can store only numbers, not text.
A spreadsheet is made up of rows, columns and ____.
Cell A1 contains 6 and cell A2 contains 4. The formula =A1*A2 gives the answer ____.
The ____ function adds up a range of numbers.
Horizontal lines of cells are called ____ and vertical lines of cells are called ____.
Give two advantages of using a spreadsheet instead of calculating by hand.
questions.answer: Any two from: calculations are fast; fewer mistakes (accurate); results update automatically when data changes; charts can be created easily; data can be sorted and filtered.

questions.q: Explain what a cell reference is.
questions.answer: A cell reference is the name of a cell (1), made from its column letter and row number, e.g. B3 (1).

questions.q: Describe how you would create a chart from a table of data.
questions.answer: Select the data including the headings (1); insert a chart and choose a suitable type (1); add a title and labels to the axes (1).
